c-bfd89bbd27c400e6.texto: Roberts thinks there is an allusion here to one mode of bathing practiced by Orientals, which is to have water poured on the body by an attendant. The Egyptian monuments give evidence that this mode was practiced in Egypt.

c-dbcfb1b79078bae1.texto: The term “molten” does not necessarily mean that the image was cast of solid metal.
